distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan, including Xishuangbanna. Smith et al. (2022) independently supports Yunnan occurrence but adds no new province or locality detail.

host_note: The existing source-supported hosts Mangifera indica and Agathis are retained at their published taxonomic resolution. Smith et al. (2022) reports no host and adds no host taxon.
